description: A single row of a grid query result.

data.description: The JSON object representing a single row.

validationResults.description: When a grid is bound to a JSON schema, each row will be validated against the schema. This represents the validation results of a single row.  Will be excluded for queries that contain any type of aggregation (count, group by...).

rowId.description: Logical timestamp identifying the row in compact form `replicaId.sequenceNumber` (e.g. `123.456`). Used in filters (RowIdFilter) and patch/update operations.
